mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stats_daily(stat_date, metric, value) VALUES(#{date}, #{metric}, #{delta}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value = value + VALUES(value)
INSERT INTO stats_total(metric, value) VALUES(#{metric}, #{delta}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value = value + VALUES(value), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT metric, value FROM stats_daily WHERE stat_date = #{date} ORDER BY metric ASC
